Title: Fine Dust Reaches Your Gut, Too: 3 Ways to Protect It

Description:
Fine dust doesn't stop at your lungs. Particles trapped in your airway mucus get swallowed straight into your stomach and gut, where they can loosen the tight junctions in your gut lining and throw off the balance of your gut bacteria. Wear a mask on high pollution days to cut down what you swallow, eat more fiber-rich vegetables to support your gut lining, and consider probiotics to help rebuild bacterial balance.
